steps.title: Initial Review + Diagnosis
steps.description: Once a team selects the players they want coached, they submit vods of custom KovaaK's scenarios and in game gameplay. The coaches at HONE take the time to review and diagnose problems.

steps.title: Get Matched With Coaches
steps.description: 2 coaches will be selected for the players who will work with them through the month or however long you've booked for. One for macro (gamesense), one for micro (mechanics).

steps.title: 2 Vod Reviews a Week (1 Month+)
steps.description: Each player gets 2 vod reviews a week with the assigned coach to ensure that practice is going smoothly and adjustments can be made swiftly.

steps.title: Maintenance (1 Month+)
steps.description: 1 vod every 2 weeks to ensure that players are still improving and practising correctly.
